bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed and searched; nonclear bags get extra inspection. Backpacks, laptop cases and other multi-compartment bags are prohibited regardless of size.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby Caesars New Orleans garages offer guest rates of $9 for six weekday hours or $14 for six weekend hours with a validation sticker from the box office or Guest Services.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue visit and parking pages do not identify a designated rideshare pickup location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are sold inside, including paid options at BG’s Lounge. Outside food and drink are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue links a separate guide for accessible arrival and seating, and asks guests to contact the box office before visiting for additional assistance.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens two hours before the posted door time on event days and closes when the headliner begins; show the live mobile ticket at entry, not a screenshot or printout.

gates.summary: General entry uses a live mobile ticket; screenshots and paper copies are not accepted. Guests with a VIP box may use a separate VIP entrance.
